# utilities.mjs

[Source](https://github.com/uol-library/spacefinder/blob/develop/assets/js/modules/utilities.mjs)

Utility functions used by the core modules and the dataset modules:
storage and data loading, finding places, building place HTML, routing
and dataset names.

**Exports:** `haversine_distance`, `getJSON`, `getPlaceById`, `getPlaceBySlug`, `getPlaceNodeById`, `getFilterData`, `escapeHTML`, `decodeHTML`, `getDirectionsLink`, `createPlaceElement`, `getInfoWindowHTML`, `setElementFocus`, `togglePanel`, `getRoute`, `getRouteURL`, `setRoute`, `getDataSourceRoute`, `getDataSourceName`, `setDataSourceNames`, `splog`

<a name="storageAvailable"></a>

## storageAvailable(type) ⇒ <code>boolean</code>
Checks to see if localStorage is available

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| type | <code>string</code> | (localStorage or sessionStorage) |

<a name="setWithExpiry"></a>

## setWithExpiry(key, value, ttl)
Sets a value in localStorage but adds expiry date

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| key | <code>string</code> | localStorage key |
| value | <code>string</code> | to set |
| ttl | <code>int</code> | Time to live (in hours) |

<a name="getWithExpiry"></a>

## getWithExpiry(key)
Gets a value in localStorage but checks expiry date
first. If expired, localStorage key is removed and
null returned.

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| key | <code>string</code> | localStorage key |

<a name="haversine_distance"></a>

## haversine\_distance(mk1, mk2) ⇒ <code>Float</code>
Uses the haversine formula to calculate the distance between 2 points on a
sphere given their longitudes and latitudes

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>Float</code> - distance between mk1 and mk2 in metres  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mk1 | <code>Object</code> | point one |
| mk2 | <code>Object</code> | point 2 |

<a name="getJSON"></a>

## getJSON(options)
Gets a JSON data file from a remote URL. Utilises localstorage
to cache the results.

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| options | <code>Object</code> | Information about the JSON file |
| options.key | <code>String</code> | Unique key used to store the data in localstorage (required) |
| options.url | <code>String</code> | URL of the JSON file (required) |
| options.expiry | <code>Integer</code> | How long to cache the results (in hours) default: 24 |
| options.callback | <code>function</code> | callback function with one parameter (JSON parsed response) |

<a name="createPlaceElement"></a>

## createPlaceElement(place, content) ⇒ <code>Element</code>
Creates the list view element for a place. The ids, classes and data
attributes used here are relied on by places.mjs, map.mjs and routing.mjs,
so data modules should use this rather than building their own.

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>Element</code> - HTML element  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| place | <code>Object</code> | place data (id, slug, title and sortKey are used) |
| content | <code>Object</code> |  |
| content.classList | <code>string</code> | classes used for filtering |
| content.typeLabel | <code>string</code> | type of place shown in the list (HTML) |
| content.typeClass | <code>string</code> | used to make the place-type-* class |
| content.address | <code>string</code> | address (HTML) |
| content.details | <code>string</code> | image, description etc. (HTML) |
| content.search | <code>string</code> | optional text to search instead of the place summary |

<a name="getInfoWindowHTML"></a>

## getInfoWindowHTML(title, info, description) ⇒ <code>string</code>
Returns HTML for a place's map infoWindow. The show-list button is used by map.mjs.

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>string</code> - HTML  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| title | <code>string</code> | place title |
| info | <code>Array</code> | short facts about the place (HTML), shown comma separated |
| description | <code>string</code> | optional description (HTML) |

<a name="getRoute"></a>

## getRoute() ⇒ <code>Array</code>
Gets the current route from the URL, e.g. [ 'spaces', '1915' ] from
/spaces/1915 (history routing) or /#/spaces/1915 (hash routing)

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>Array</code> - route segments  
<a name="getRouteURL"></a>

## getRouteURL(route) ⇒ <code>string</code>
Returns the URL for a route

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>string</code> - URL  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| route | <code>string</code> | e.g. spaces/1915 (empty for the home page) |

<a name="setRoute"></a>

## setRoute(route, replace)
Sets the route in the URL, adding a history entry if it has changed

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| route | <code>string</code> | e.g. spaces/1915 (empty for the home page) |
| replace | <code>boolean</code> | replace the current history entry rather than adding one |

<a name="getDataSourceRoute"></a>

## getDataSourceRoute(key) ⇒ <code>string</code>
Returns the route for a dataset - the default dataset is the home page

**Returns**: <code>string</code> - route

<a name="getDataSourceName"></a>

## getDataSourceName(key) ⇒ <code>string</code>
Gets the name of a dataset for use in a sentence, e.g. "study spaces"
(the name from config, or the label in lower case)

**Kind**: global function  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| key | <code>string</code> | dataset key (defaults to the current dataset) |

<a name="setDataSourceNames"></a>

## setDataSourceNames()
Puts the current dataset's name in the interface text: the content of
elements with the datasource-name class, and the title of elements with
a data-datasource-title attribute ({name} is replaced with the name)

**Kind**: global function
